title: Ember glands stored at The Crucible Garrison carried two jumps to the War Citadel (Krynn), where its bid and Station Need pay
note: Written by Mercury, 2026-11-23 18:57 UTC (orders ENT-083, block MERCURY: sell handed goods at or above the bids). Ember glands bid 480 cr at The Crucible and 7,054 cr x 2 at the War Citadel, whose Station Need missions pay about 8,100 cr a gland (need-ember-gland-krynn). A trader stores 7 glands at The Crucible (holdings, storage book 18:29 UTC). The Crucible to Krynn: 2 jumps through Iron Reach, Crimson policed space (scripts/map.py route), no pirate in 97 to 212 readings (data/intel/sightings.jsonl). It carries them and stores them there for need-ember-gland-krynn and sell-loot-at-krynn. requires.stored: only a pilot whose own storage at The Crucible holds 3 glands; max_jumps 3 keeps it to a ship near. One ship.
